formatNote: This is the Design Source of Truth for R8B-R8G, expressed as a structured JSON design document because Pen.dev is not installed in this environment (see PHASE-R8A-REPORT.md, 'Pen.dev environment'). It is NOT a native Pen.dev binary document. It carries the same five top-level areas a Pen.dev document would, builds components before screens, and is machine-consumable by R8B. Importing it into a Pen.dev workspace is a mechanical translation, not a redesign.

target: technical without looking like a terminal
designLanguage.identityStatement: DSH Remote is a Chat Client, not a Terminal Client.

01_Foundations.note: Values live in design/design-tokens.json. This area documents intent and the rules that bind components.

spacing.rule: Only these eight values may be used for margin, padding and gap.

typography.rule: Chat body is 15px. Caption is the only style below 14px and is never used for message content.

touchTargets.note: Applies to every primary interaction, including the code-block copy button and drawer rows.

messageWidth.assistantCodeBlock: 100% of available content width, horizontally scrollable
messageWidth.rule: A code block never widens the page; it scrolls inside its own container.

elevation.rule: Depth is conveyed by surface colour and a 1px border, not by heavy shadow.

02_Components.note: Component-first. Every screen is composed from these; no screen defines a private one-off.

items.name: AppShell
items.purpose: Owns the viewport frame: TopBar, banner slot, content area, drawer host, dialog host, toast host.
items.disabled: n/a — structural
items.mobile: Single column. Drawer is an overlay, not part of the flow, below 768px.
items.accessibility: Exactly one main landmark; the drawer is a complementary landmark when open.

items.name: TopBar
items.purpose: Identity, connection state, and the entry point to the session drawer.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: 56px tall, respects the top safe area, title truncates with ellipsis.
items.accessibility: Title is a heading; the menu button is labelled 'Sessions'.

items.name: MenuButton
items.purpose: Opens the session drawer.
items.disabled: Disabled while a fatal state blocks interaction.
items.mobile: 44x44 hit area even though the glyph is smaller.
items.accessibility: aria-expanded reflects drawer state; aria-controls names the drawer.

items.name: ConnectionBadge
items.purpose: Shows the UI connection state at a glance and opens detail on tap.
items.disabled: Not disabled in fatal states — it is the only place the failure is named.
items.mobile: Icon plus short label; collapses to icon plus dot below 380px.
items.accessibility: Each variant has a distinct icon AND text label; colour is never the only cue. A live region announces transitions.

items.name: SessionDrawer
items.purpose: Slide-over navigation for sessions, new-session entry, connection status and settings.
items.disabled: Rows are disabled while the drawer is mid-transition.
items.mobile: Slide-over from the leading edge, 300px, scrim at rgba(8,10,14,0.62), focus trapped while open.
items.accessibility: role=dialog when overlay; Escape closes; focus returns to MenuButton on close.

items.name: SessionList
items.purpose: Scrollable list of sessions with loading, empty and error states.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Scrolling must not move the chat behind the scrim.
items.accessibility: role=list; row count announced; skeleton rows carry aria-busy.

items.name: SessionItem
items.purpose: One session row: title, last-activity hint, and status.
items.disabled: Disabled only when the connection cannot serve a switch.
items.mobile: 56px minimum row height; long titles wrap to two lines then ellipsise.
items.accessibility: aria-current for the active session; running and failed carry icon plus text.

items.name: NewSessionButton
items.purpose: Creates a session and opens it.
items.disabled: Disabled when disconnected or when a create is already in flight.
items.mobile: Full-width row inside the drawer; 44px minimum height.
items.accessibility: Labels the outcome ('New session'), not the mechanism.
items.futureDependency: POST /api/v1/sessions (contract reserved; R8A does not call it)

items.name: MessageTimeline
items.purpose: Scrollable transcript of messages in order.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Auto-sticks to the bottom while streaming unless the user has scrolled up; then a 'jump to latest' affordance appears.
items.accessibility: role=log with aria-live=polite so new messages and stream completion are announced, never every chunk.

items.name: UserMessage
items.purpose: A message authored by the operator.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Right-aligned, max 85% width, preserves user line breaks verbatim.
items.accessibility: Labelled as the user's message for screen readers.

items.name: AssistantMessage
items.purpose: A message authored by DSH, including streamed content.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Left-aligned, max 85% width; code blocks may use full width and scroll.
items.accessibility: Stream completion is announced once; chunks are not.

items.name: SystemMessage
items.purpose: Non-conversational notices such as session start or a policy note.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Centred, muted, max 90% width.
items.accessibility: Not announced as a chat turn.

items.name: ErrorMessage
items.purpose: A failed turn or a failed action, with a recovery affordance.
items.disabled: Retry is disabled while a retry is in flight.
items.mobile: Inline in the timeline where the failure occurred; never a modal.
items.accessibility: role=alert on appearance; the message states what failed and what the user can do.

items.name: StreamingIndicator
items.purpose: Shows that an assistant turn is actively producing output.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: A caret at the end of partial text, plus a subtle glyph near the connection badge.
items.accessibility: aria-busy on the streaming message; reduced motion swaps the animation for a static caret.

items.name: Composer
items.purpose: Composes and sends text, attachments and control actions for the current session.
items.disabled: Disabled when disconnected or fatal; the textarea stays readable so a draft is never lost.
items.mobile: Grows to at most 40% of viewport height then scrolls internally; sits above the keyboard.
items.accessibility: The textarea is labelled 'Message'; the primary action's accessible name states queue versus steer explicitly.
items.semanticRule: See 04_States.composerSemantics — the primary action never changes queue/steer meaning silently.

items.name: ComposerTextArea
items.purpose: Multiline message input.
items.disabled: Editable-but-unsendable when disconnected, so a draft survives the outage.
items.mobile: Auto-grows with newlines; Enter inserts a newline, the send action is an explicit button.
items.accessibility: Label persists when the placeholder disappears.

items.name: UploadButton
items.purpose: Selects an image or file to attach.
items.disabled: Disabled while disconnected, while at the attachment limit, or during an upload.
items.mobile: 44x44 icon button at the composer's leading edge.
items.accessibility: Announces accepted types and the 25 MiB limit before opening the picker.

items.name: SendButton
items.purpose: The primary send action. Its label states the effect.
items.disabled: Disabled when the draft is empty, while disconnected, or while a send is in flight.
items.mobile: 44x44, trailing edge.
items.accessibility: Accessible name is 'Send' when idle and 'Send later (queues)' when the session is running — never an unlabelled state change.

items.name: SteerButton
items.purpose: Redirects the currently running task with the drafted text.
items.disabled: Visible and enabled only while the session is running AND the draft is non-empty.
items.mobile: Rendered as an explicit secondary action beside Send later, not hidden in a menu.
items.accessibility: Accessible name 'Steer current task'; a confirmation toast restates what happened.
items.futureDependency: POST messages with steer intent (contract reserved)

items.name: CancelButton
items.purpose: Cancels the running turn.
items.disabled: Visible only while running; disabled while a cancel is in flight.
items.mobile: Placed with the streaming indicator so it is reachable without scrolling.
items.accessibility: Accessible name 'Cancel run'; the state change is announced.

items.name: QueueIndicator
items.purpose: Shows how many messages are queued behind the running turn.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Compact chip above the composer.
items.accessibility: Text form ('2 queued'), not a bare number badge.

items.name: WaitingInputIndicator
items.purpose: Shows that DSH is waiting for the operator to answer.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Banner-like strip directly above the composer, which becomes visually emphasized.
items.accessibility: role=status; announces once when the state begins.

items.name: AttachmentChip
items.purpose: One selected or uploaded attachment.
items.disabled: Remove is disabled while the chip is uploading.
items.mobile: Horizontal scroll strip; chip removes on tap of a 44px target.
items.accessibility: Names the file and its state; failure is text, not colour.

items.name: UploadProgressChip
items.purpose: Progress for one in-flight upload.
items.disabled: Retry disabled unless the failure is known to be retryable.
items.mobile: Replaces the AttachmentChip's trailing slot; never blocks the composer.
items.accessibility: role=progressbar with a text fallback.

items.name: ReconnectBanner
items.purpose: A lightweight notice that the live link dropped and is being re-established.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: 40px strip under the TopBar; message history stays visible and scrollable.
items.accessibility: role=status, polite; the reconnected variant confirms recovery once and then leaves.

items.name: ResyncBanner
items.purpose: Explains that the conversation changed while offline and offers a reload.
items.disabled: Reload disabled while a reload is in flight.
items.mobile: Occupies the banner slot with a one-line explanation and a single primary action.
items.accessibility: role=alert; the action names the outcome ('Reload conversation').

items.name: CredentialDialog
items.purpose: Collects the Phone Access Token.
items.disabled: Connect disabled while empty or submitting.
items.mobile: Full-screen sheet on phones; centred dialog at 768px and above.
items.accessibility: Focus moves to the field on open; the field is labelled and its content is masked with a reveal toggle; errors are announced.
items.securityRule: The token is never placed in a URL, never re-rendered after success, never echoed in an error, and never stored in localStorage or IndexedDB.

items.name: Toast
items.purpose: Transient confirmation or failure for an action.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Bottom-anchored above the composer; auto-dismiss with a manual dismiss target.
items.accessibility: role=status for success and info, role=alert for danger; never the only record of a failure.

items.name: EmptyState
items.purpose: Explains an empty surface and offers the next action.
items.disabled: Action disabled when the connection cannot serve it.
items.mobile: Centred, max 90% width, icon plus one sentence plus at most one primary action.
items.accessibility: Heading plus body; the action is a real button, not a link-styled div.

items.name: LoadingState
items.purpose: A bounded wait with a stable layout.
items.disabled: n/a
items.mobile: Skeletons match the final row heights so nothing shifts on load.
items.accessibility: aria-busy on the region; a text alternative after a short delay.

items.name: FatalErrorState
items.purpose: An unrecoverable condition with the one action that helps.
items.disabled: Retry disabled only while a retry is in flight.
items.mobile: Full-screen, replaces the chat surface; the Composer is not shown.
items.accessibility: role=alert; states plainly what is wrong and what the operator should do outside the UI.
items.contentRule: Names the condition in operator language. Never shows a stack trace, a credential, a cookie, a ticket or a filesystem path.

03_MobileScreens.note: Screens are compositions of 02_Components only. No screen defines a private component.

items.name: Ready Chat
items.description: The default working view. Stable transcript, connection badge in Ready, composer idle with the primary action labelled Send.

viewportNotes.768x1024: valid — session rail visible, chat constrained to 720px content width

items.name: Assistant Streaming
items.description: An assistant turn is producing output. Partial text grows in ONE message; a caret marks the stream head. Send is labelled 'Send later' and an explicit Steer button sits beside it. Cancel is reachable without scrolling.

items.name: Message Queued
items.description: The drafted message has been queued behind the running turn. The queued message renders as a UserMessage variant 'queued' with a text marker, and the QueueIndicator shows a text count. The Send action remains available and still reads 'Send later' so the user is never guessing.

items.name: Waiting for Input
items.description: DSH is blocked on an operator answer. A WaitingInputIndicator sits directly above the composer, which becomes visually emphasized; the primary action returns to plain 'Send' because a waiting-input reply is neither a queue nor a steer.
explicitlyDesigned: primary action semantics for a reply

items.name: Reconnecting
items.description: The live link dropped. A lightweight ReconnectBanner appears under the TopBar. History stays fully visible and scrollable; nothing is cleared and the user is not returned to the credential screen. Compose stays editable but send is disabled.
explicitlyDesigned: disabled send with an explanatory label

items.name: Resync Required
items.description: The Gateway reports that the conversation changed while the client was offline. The banner states this plainly and offers exactly one action, 'Reload conversation'. Four sub-states are designed: before reload, reloading, reload succeeded, reload failed.

items.name: Session Drawer Open
items.description: Slide-over navigation over the chat. Contains identity, New Session, the session list with all five item variants, connection status and a settings/auth entry. Chat remains mounted behind the scrim.

viewportNotes.768x1024: valid — becomes a persistent side rail instead of an overlay

items.name: File Upload
items.description: An image or file is selected or uploading. AttachmentChips scroll horizontally; a failed chip offers remove and re-select. The composer is never blocked by an upload. Client pre-checks the 25 MiB limit; the server stays the authority.
explicitlyDesigned: failure recovery without assuming a retry endpoint

items.name: Phone Token Authentication
items.description: Manual Phone Access Token entry. Field, reveal toggle, Connect. On success the dialog closes and the token is never rendered again anywhere in the interface.
securityConstraints: token never visually echoed after connection
token never rendered in logs or errors
no QR containing a long-lived bearer

items.name: Gateway Unavailable / Fatal
items.description: The Gateway cannot be reached or is incompatible. The chat surface is replaced, the composer is not shown, and the copy tells the operator what to do outside the interface. No lifecycle control is offered.
explicitlyDesigned: absence of stack traces and credentials

items.name: Empty Session
items.description: Auxiliary acceptance screen. A session exists but has no messages: an EmptyState explains the surface and points at the composer. Never a blank screen.

items.name: Failed Message
items.description: Auxiliary acceptance screen. A send failed: an inline ErrorMessage sits where the turn failed, the draft is preserved, and the recovery affordance is a retry that does not duplicate the message.

04_States.note: Domain state and connection state are INDEPENDENT axes and are never merged into one enum.

domainStates.source: R2 domain status — fixed. No ninth status may be added.

mapping.ui: QueueIndicator with a text count; the queued message renders as UserMessage variant queued; send behaviour is stated explicitly
StreamingIndicator on one growing assistant message; CancelButton visible; primary action relabelled 'Send later'; SteerButton offered as an explicit secondary action
Composer emphasized; WaitingInputIndicator above it; primary action is a plain reply
stable, final message state; stream cursor removed
ErrorMessage inline at the point of failure with a recovery affordance
cancelled marker on the affected message; composer returns to idle

connectionStates.source: UI-only. Distinct from, and independent of, domain status.

legalCombinations.note: legal: the turn was running when the link dropped
legal; the reply is drafted but unsendable

composerSemantics.rule: The primary action NEVER changes queue/steer meaning silently. Its label states the effect at all times.

byState.effect: QUEUE the message behind the running turn

composerSemantics.explicitlyForbidden: A single button whose queue/steer semantics change with state without a visible label change.

streamingState.sense: The user can always tell whether the assistant is still producing output.
subStates: cursor-stalled (no chunk recently, link still up)

rendering.start: create ONE transient AssistantMessage in the streaming variant
rendering.chunk: append visible content to that same message
rendering.end: finalize the message and remove the cursor

streamingState.explicitlyForbidden: Rendering each chunk as a separate message.

05_InteractionFlows.note: Full narrative in docs/remote-mobile/R8-INTERACTION-FLOWS.md. Each flow names the components it uses and its future API/event dependency.

flows.name: Authentication
steps: success: close dialog, token never shown again
failure: invalid variant, no credential echoed

flows.name: Send (queue)
steps: primary action reads 'Send later' while running

flows.name: Streaming
steps: assistant_stream_chunk -> append to the SAME message

flows.name: Reconnect
steps: reconnecting: ReconnectBanner, history retained, send disabled

flows.name: Replay
steps: replay frames applied silently or minimally

flows.name: Resync
steps: ResyncBanner: 'Conversation changed while you were offline.'
